gap_details.2011-2012: RECONSTRUCTED, significance LOW. Still no roster capture (Wayback none 2010-10-27..2012-12-03; CC-MAIN-2012 rescanned on the whole departments_and_services/neurosurgery prefix: no roster). Phase 2 settled the class-of-2016 swap with other programs' rosters: Aronson is PGY3 on the MGH Jan-2012 roster (left BWH at end of 2010-11); Raber (UAMS, Feb-2012) and Abd-El-Barr (UF, Oct-2011) were still at their home programs in 2011-12 and joined BWH at PGY4 in 2012-13. The only open point is whether Kellogg (switched to neurology) left in 2011 or 2012; every other class is bracketed and the complement (2/yr) matches.
gap_details.2013-2014: RECONSTRUCTED, significance NONE. Every class is bracketed by the 2012-13 and 2014-15 rosters and the alumni list, and no class changes size across the gap. Phase 2: Common Crawl 2013-2014 rescanned on the whole departments_and_services/neurosurgery and /neurosurgery prefixes (only ResidentHome/alumni/fellowship pages); PubMed BWH-neurosurgery affiliation mining for 2013-14 found no unlisted resident.

gap_details.2022-2023: Plain URL only captured 2022-07-05 (stale 2021-22 content) then 2024-04; a 2022-12-03 capture of the ?TRILIBIS_EMULATOR_UA= variant gives 2022-23 (used).
gap_details.2025-2026: Dec-2025 capture (20 residents, PGY1 Patel/Savchuk) + MGB brochure Jan 2026 adding Maren Loe PGY1 ('other' entry).
gap_details.2026-2027: MISSING, significance SIGNIFICANT (not closable). No 2026-27 roster exists online. Live MGB page research.massgeneralbrigham.org/.../mgb-neurosurgery-residency-program has no roster. Its brochure PDF is byte-identical to the Jan-2026 copy (ModDate 2026-01-05, 2025-26 content). The research-site sitemap (674 URLs) has no residents page. Wayback has no current-residents capture after 2026-04-14. Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2026-30 has a 2026-07-12 capture of brighamandwomens.org/neurosurgery/residency/current-residents; it is still the unchanged 2025-26 list (same 20 names and PGYs), so it was not loaded. The page now redirects to massgeneralbrigham.org. The integrated MGB program's first interns (matched Mar 2026) belong to the new program, not to 37. Legacy BWH residents expected in 2026-27 are the 18 residents who were PGY1-6 in 2025-26 (now PGY2-7). Publications from Jun-Sep 2026 give a Mass General Brigham or BWH neurosurgery affiliation for J. Chalif, Glaser, Luiselli, Nwagwu, Maury and R. Patel, but no PGY. The other 12 have no 2026 evidence either way. The three 2025-26 PGY7s (Bernstock, Chua, Gupta) were recorded as graduating in 2026 from the PGY-terminal roster; Gupta has a Stanford neurosurgery affiliation from Jul 2026.
